mainText: Hello, Verona! At 11 AM, here is today's balanced dish: expect 71 degrees with overcast skies near the Verona Public Library and an air quality index of 51 during this full moon period.

September is upon us, and the city has proclaimed it both Hunger Action and Suicide Prevention Month to support those in need. Additionally, please plan for extra travel time on Highway M due to construction flagging, and join the city in celebrating our local building and code staff today.

There is plenty to do, starting with the Dane County Farmers Market today and live music performances at Baileys Run, Paddy Macs, and the Wisconsin Brewing Company. Tomorrow, the Verona Area Kids Triathlon takes place at the high school, followed by the Girls Try Hockey event at the Verona Ice Arena.
In our weekly look at local reports, on August 17, officers successfully located and arrested a 21 year old man in the 500 block of Cross Country Road regarding a probation violation.
Today is the perfect day to stop by for our flavor of the day, Mint Explosion. The store is currently open and will be serving until 10:30 PM tonight.
